body: The Ridge Warden stands as a testament to innovation, craftsmanship, and rugged luxury. Built on the Mercedes Sprinter 170 EXT AWD platform by Papago Vans, this camper van was custom-designed to push the boundaries of off-road capability and off-grid living. Every element of this build combines precision engineering and thoughtful design, making it the ultimate vehicle for tackling remote trails and embracing long-term travel.

Powered by a 400W solar system, an 800Ah lithium battery, and a 3000W pure sine wave inverter, The Ridge Warden provides reliable power to run all its systems, even in the most isolated locations. It’s designed for serious adventurers, featuring a King Shock Lift Kit for superior handling on uneven terrain, all-terrain wheels and tires for maximum grip, and a Warn 12s winch integrated into the FVCO front bumper to overcome challenging obstacles. A FVCO Safari Roof Rack with deck panels transforms the roof into a spacious platform, perfect for unwinding after a day of exploration or enjoying sweeping views of the wilderness.

Inside, The Ridge Warden offers an unparalleled living experience. The interior combines rugged functionality with sophisticated styling, featuring acoustic walnut slat ceilings, Papago White shiplap walls, and English Chestnut-stained trim that create a warm and welcoming space. The advanced lighting package includes recessed LED strips running the length of the ceiling and ambient lighting under the counters, adding a modern touch while ensuring ample illumination for any activity.

The fully equipped kitchen ensures that meal preparation is as seamless as it is stylish. It includes an Acacia butcher block countertop, a double burner induction cooktop, a 700W microwave, and an Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator with freezer. A fold-down table accessible from the sliding door and a pop-up countertop extension provide additional prep space and versatility, making it easy to cook both indoors and outdoors.

Comfort and convenience are central to The Ridge Warden. The queen-size memory foam bed provides a restful retreat, while the tiled wet-bath shower with a Laveo Dry Flush Toilet ensures you have the comforts of home wherever you go. The Espar diesel heater and 12V Cruise N Comfort A/C unit keep the interior climate comfortable year-round, while premium insulation ensures energy efficiency and soundproofing.

Ample storage solutions make this van ready for extended trips. It features multiple under-counter cabinets, overhead compartments, a headliner shelf, and even a secure 0.7 cu/ft safe, ensuring you can bring all your essentials while staying organized. For connectivity on the go, The Ridge Warden is equipped with a WeBoost cell signal booster and Starlink in-motion internet, allowing for seamless communication and streaming even in remote areas.

Additional features that set this build apart include custom magnetic blackout window shades for privacy and temperature control, an electric graywater dump system, and exterior upgrades like Baja Designs LED light pods integrated into the FVCO bumpers, providing exceptional visibility in low-light conditions. The rear door platform and Owl Vans rear storage box offer extra gear storage, while the side ladder and rocker lockers add accessibility and durability.

The Ridge Warden is a true masterpiece, built for a discerning adventurer who wanted the ultimate in off-road performance and luxury living. From its rooftop deck to its premium interior and over-the-top features, this custom camper van embodies the pinnacle of design, functionality, and rugged elegance. It’s not just a vehicle—it’s a statement of exploration, freedom, and limitless possibility.
